rows.Origin:
Bred by Gareth Fryer (1948-....) (United Kingdom, 2003).
Introduced in United Kingdom by Fryer's Roses/Fryer's Nurseries Ltd. in 2004 as 'Tawny Tiger'.
rows.Bloom: Orange, brown stripes. Semi-double (9-16 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Breeder's notes: Brown and terracotta stripes! This is an extraordinary new floribunda and a definite colour break. Semi-double flowers of rich dark orange, amazingly striped and rippled with terracotta and brown that attractively combines to dramatic effect. It is bushy and loaded with blooms - sure to provide an interesting discussion point when planted at the front of a mixed border! 70cms.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes: Plant height considerably taller in warmer climates.
